blocks.orig: Our safaris in Tanzania offer an opportunity to explore the country’s incredible wildlife and stunning landscapes. We specialize in private safaris, which means you have a 4×4 Landcruiser or jeep all to yourselves. You have the flexibility to decide when the safari starts and ends, and our experienced guides can help you make that decision on the day of your adventure. Whether you want to witness the animals at their most active during sunrise and sunset when temperatures are pleasant, or if you fancy ending the day by the pool, it’s entirely up to you. Tanzania’s diverse wildlife is active at various times of the day, so you’ll have plenty of opportunities to spot the animals in action.
blocks.html: On a safari with us you get the chance to discover Tanzania’s remarkable wildlife and beautiful scenery. Because animals in Tanzania are active at different times of day, you will have many chances to see them in action.

blocks.orig: Absolutely, Tanzania is renowned as one of the prime destinations to encounter the Big Five. These magnificent creatures—lion, leopard, elephant, rhinoceros, and buffalo—can be observed in their natural habitats, making Tanzania a preferred choice for wildlife enthusiasts.
blocks.html: Yes, Tanzania is known as one of the best places to see the Big Five. Lion, leopard, elephant, rhinoceros and buffalo can all be seen in their natural surroundings, which is why so many wildlife lovers choose Tanzania.

blocks.orig: Absolutely, Tanzania is a safe and welcoming destination for travelers. The country offers a hospitable environment, especially in tourist areas like Arusha, and you can explore its beautiful landscapes and wildlife with confidence. Local people are friendly, and safety measures, such as keeping an eye on your belongings, are always advisable, just as you would in any other part of the world. Tanzania’s natural beauty and the warmth of its people make it a fantastic place to visit.
blocks.html: Yes, Tanzania is a safe and friendly country for travellers. You will find a hospitable atmosphere, particularly in tourist areas such as Arusha, and you can enjoy the scenery and wildlife with peace of mind. People are welcoming, and as anywhere else in the world it is sensible to take normal precautions, such as watching your belongings. With its natural beauty and warm people, Tanzania is a wonderful country to visit.

blocks.orig: Welcome to Mafia, a stunning destination in Tanzania that will captivate your senses. With beautiful beaches, crystal clear turquoise waters, and a rich marine ecosystem, Mafia offers a paradise-like experience. Dive into the depths of the Mafia Marine Park, explore its coral reefs, and encounter vibrant unde life. Immerse yourself in the local culture and history, and visit ancient ruins and picturesque fishing villages. Indulge in fresh seafood and enjoy the tranquility of this hidden gem. Your journey to Mafia promises an unforgettable adventure in an idyllic tropical paradise.
blocks.html: Mafia is a beautiful destination in Tanzania that appeals to all your senses. Its lovely beaches, clear turquoise water and rich marine ecosystem make it feel like paradise. Dive down into the Mafia Marine Park, explore the coral reefs and meet the colourful underwater life. Get to know the local culture and history, with visits to ancient ruins and charming fishing villages. Treat yourself to fresh seafood and enjoy the calm of this hidden gem. A trip to Mafia means a memorable adventure in an idyllic tropical paradise.

blocks.orig: Experience paradise on Mafia Island, nestled in the mesmerizing Indian Ocean. Uncover pristine white sandy beaches, crystal-clear turquoise waters, and vibrant coral reefs. Dive into a world of marine wonders, swim with gentle whale sharks, and explore stunning underwater ecosystems. Immerse yourself in the rich culture and traditions of the local communities. Relax, unwind, and embrace the peacefulness of this untouched island paradise. Mafia Island is the ultimate destination for an unforgettable tropical adventure.
blocks.html: Mafia Island, set in the captivating Indian Ocean, is a true paradise. Discover untouched white sandy beaches, clear turquoise water and colourful coral reefs. Explore a world of marine wonders, swim alongside gentle whale sharks and discover beautiful underwater ecosystems. Learn about the rich culture and traditions of the local communities. Unwind, relax and enjoy the calm of this unspoilt island paradise. For a memorable tropical adventure, Mafia Island is the place to go.

blocks.orig: After some unforgettable days on Mafia Island, it's time to bid farewell to this exotic paradise. It might leave you with a bittersweet taste in your mouth, to leave this blissful paradise behind. But at least you can cherish the memories and pictures of snorkelling alongside colourful coral reefs and maybe even those of swimming with gentle whale sharks. As you step on the plane, please take a moment to reflect on the peacefulness and tranquillity of Mafia Island, and bid it goodbye with one last look at its beaches, palm trees and the ocean.
